titulo: The Plant That Counts Before It Snaps
tema: Como a Venus flytrap (planta carnívora) sabe contar os toques antes de fechar a armadilha
estilo_visual: Photorealistic nature documentary photograph, soft even overcast light, dark mossy background, natural muted green and deep red colors, sharp focus on a single subject.

audio.como_ler: picos_cortados.trechos > 0 = distorção; silencios = buraco de 0,7 s ou mais no meio do vídeo; saltos_volume = volume muda 6 LU ou mais em 1 s; voz_abafada = trecho em que a música (ou ruído) preenche os vãos da fala (heurística: confirme pela transcrição)

cenas.narracao: This plant can count, and it never snaps shut by mistake. Here is how.
cenas.quadro: A single green Venus flytrap plant with red-pink inner lobes and fine green teeth along the edges, trap wide open and perfectly still, centered on dark wet moss, soft even overcast light, empty trap, nothing inside, nothing else in the frame, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still

cenas.narracao: Inside every open trap are tiny hairs. Brush one a single time, and nothing happens.
cenas.quadro: Close macro view of the red-pink inner surface of a single green Venus flytrap plant, trap wide open and still, fine green teeth along the edge, soft even overcast light, dark mossy background, empty trap, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still

cenas.narracao: The plant waits. If a second touch follows quickly, it decides something alive is inside.
cenas.quadro: A single green Venus flytrap plant with red-pink inner lobes, trap open and still, seen from slightly above, dark wet moss below, soft even overcast light, empty trap, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still

cenas.narracao: A raindrop or a falling leaf may tickle one hair. The trap simply stays open.
cenas.quadro: A single green Venus flytrap plant with red-pink inner lobes and fine green teeth, trap open and calm, seen from the side at eye level with the plant, dark moss background, soft even overcast light, empty trap, nothing else in the frame, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still

cenas.narracao: Here is the twist. If nothing moves inside, the trap slowly opens again, as if it never happened.
cenas.quadro: A single green Venus flytrap plant with its trap half closed, green teeth loosely crossing, red-pink inside barely visible, held perfectly still on dark wet moss, soft even overcast light, nothing else in the frame, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still

cenas.narracao: Struggling prey keeps touching the hairs, so the trap seals tight. Every wasted snap costs the plant energy.
cenas.quadro: A single green Venus flytrap plant with its trap fully closed, green teeth tightly interlocked like a cage, centered on dark wet moss, soft even overcast light, nothing else in the frame, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still

cenas.narracao: A plant with no brain counts touches. It waits, it checks, and it never snaps by mistake.
cenas.quadro: A single green Venus flytrap plant with red-pink inner lobes and fine green teeth, trap wide open and still, centered on dark wet moss, soft even overcast light, empty trap, nothing else in the frame, no insects, no water drops, no people, no text
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, everything else completely still
